name: @equin/plugin-integrations-google-pubsub
description: Stateless Google Cloud Pub/Sub REST client over the user's own Google connection: topics, a topic's IAM publisher grant, pull subscriptions, held pulls and acks, every answer zod-parsed and a refusal typed (PubSubApiError: status, reason, the API-activation link when the project has Pub/Sub turned off). The pubsub OAuth scope, its token broker and the grant affordance.
